patterns.label: Qameṣ
patterns.explain: It is a qameṣ: it stands in an open syllable.

patterns.label: Qameṣ
patterns.explain: It is a qameṣ: it is followed by a simple vocal sheva (usually accompanied by a meteg).

patterns.label: Qameṣ
patterns.explain: It is a qameṣ: it is in a closed accented syllable.

patterns.label: Qameṣ
patterns.explain: It is a qameṣ: it is in a closed unaccented syllable, but the syllable has a meteg.

patterns.label: Qameṣ-ḥaṭuf
patterns.explain: It is a qameṣ-ḥaṭuf: it is in a closed unaccented syllable.

patterns.label: Qameṣ-ḥaṭuf
patterns.explain: It is a qameṣ-ḥaṭuf: it stands in an open syllable, but it precedes a ḥāṭef-qāmeṣ.

patterns.label: Qameṣ-ḥaṭuf
patterns.explain: It is a qameṣ-ḥaṭuf: it stands in an open syllable, but it precedes another qameṣ-ḥaṭuf.

passages.title: Genesis 1:21
passages.note: Qameṣ and qameṣ-ḥaṭuf in one verse.

passages.title: Genesis 2:1–2
passages.note: The heavens and the earth were finished.

passages.title: Genesis 4:21–22
passages.note: Names of Jabal, Jubal and Tubal-cain.
